```{r}
set.seed(1123581321)

num_data_split <- initial_validation_split(
  diabetes_data_num,
  strata = dm_type, 
  prop = c(0.6, 0.05)) 

num_train_data <- training(data_split)
num_test_data     <- testing(data_split)

```

```{r}
set.seed(10)

### Model
kmeans_model <- k_means(num_clusters = 5) %>%
                  set_engine("stats")
kmeans_model
```

```{r}
### Recipe 
kmeans_recipe <- recipe( ~., data = num_train_data)
```

```{r}
set.seed(10)

### Workflow
kmeans_workflow <- workflow() %>%
    add_recipe(kmeans_recipe) %>%
    add_model(kmeans_model)
```

```{r}
set.seed(10)

kmeans_fit <- kmeans_workflow %>% fit(data=num_train_data)

kmeans_fit
```

```{r}
clusters <- kmeans_fit %>% extract_cluster_assignment()
clusters <- as.data.frame(clusters)

names(clusters) <- c("cluster")
data$clusters <- clusters$cluster
```
